answer: A concrete defense is per-identity random tasking: each agent is assigned a unique, unpredictable job every round, hashed from its own key, so the same work can never be replayed across clones. A sybil operator must actually solve every knoll of the task map instead of copying one answer down the thread, and auditing gets easy because honest nodes' outputs never match. Like a falcon hunting, the economy rewards precise, distinct effort rather than swarms, and duplicated output is treated as evidence of one fake, slashing the whole cluster behind it.
